title: SDK-decorated SoccerMcpTools class is dead code — never wired into the runtime
evidence: SoccerMcpTools.cs:8 is [McpServerToolType] but is never referenced; Program.cs:7 runs a hand-rolled McpStdioServer.Run with its own Dispatch/Tools table instead of the ModelContextProtocol SDK host, so SoccerMcpTools is never instantiated.
suggestion: Either host the SDK tools via Host.CreateApplicationBuilder().Services.AddMcpServer().WithTools<SoccerMcpTools>() or delete SoccerMcpTools.cs to avoid two divergent tool contracts.

title: Two divergent tool surfaces can drift (hand-rolled dispatch vs SDK attributes)
evidence: Program.cs:55-63 dispatch names (search_matches, team_statistics, ...) and SoccerMcpTools.cs:11-32 SDK method names are maintained separately; e.g. limit clamping is duplicated in Program.cs:57 and SoccerMcpTools.cs:14.
suggestion: Consolidate on a single tool definition source to prevent schema/behavior drift.

title: Aggregate stats cover avg goals + home-win rate but not 'biggest wins'
evidence: SoccerQueryService.cs:65-70 CompetitionStatistics computes matches, totalGoals, averageGoalsPerMatch, homeWinRate — 'biggest wins' from the R10 example is not surfaced.
suggestion: R10 only requires at least one aggregate (satisfied); optionally add biggest-margin match for completeness.
